note: admissible: this row carries every condition needed to compare it with another

excluded: connections captured in closures rather than stored on a handle: UIDragDetector (setDragDetector), touch gestures (setTouchGestureHandlers) and the CanvasPosition observer (observeScroll) each return a detach function and hold their connection there
anything the engine allocates internally, which is not observable from script
connections.note: adapter-held RBXScriptConnections reachable from a handle, plus the live global and any in-flight pointer capture. An undercount by construction, and the exclusions are listed rather than implied.

foreign.note: GUIs in PlayerGui that Facet does not own (Roblox core scripts, other systems); counted separately so they never inflate Facet's cost

memory.totalMbNote: totalMb is the whole client process on the development host, not Facet's share
memory.guiMbNote: Stats' whole Gui memory tag for the client process, NOT Facet's share; only guiMbDelta (the change across the workload) is attributable

seriesAgreement.note: Stats.FrameTime and the Heartbeat interval measure different things and do not always agree; when they diverge, nothing here adjudicates it, so both are published under their own names and neither is called 'the' frame work

frame.note: measured in a Studio Play session on the development host. It is not the frame work of any device, and it is not Facet's share of the frame — that is M2.
frame.headline: Stats.RenderCPUFrameTime

heartbeatInterval.what: RunService.Heartbeat delta — the frame INTERVAL, floor-limited by any frame-rate cap; NOT frame work

frameTime.what: Stats.FrameTime — published under its own name and NOT called frame work: across these captures it read a pinned multiple of the frame interval, which looks like a units or cadence artifact rather than a measurement of this screen

detail.note: One container move per FRAME (the header's height), hosted against unhosted at matched N — artifacts/nested-instance-tree/live-probes.md §4 measured this exact shape at 241 engine Position writes becoming 1 in Studio; this is whether that shows up in a frame. Read `hosted` and `hostedRepeat` FIRST: their difference is the harness spread. `scrollHosted` is the oracle, not the arm's name. Lune = regression signal, this lab under Studio = real engine, device = the only device claim.
